# Windows private-console fixture

✅ Component verified with a fresh SDK10.0.401 compile (zero diagnostics) and one actual no-signal tiny for the frozen implementation bytes. Three natural exits are zero; inner3/outer4 reach zero and all cleanup/publication errors are absent. Evidence: [portable acceptance](../../../../docs/evidence/p2/formatter-private-console-port-v1.json). P2-08.02 remains 🚧 In progress. The historical v9 result is retained separately. This Windows x64 fixture retains actual native PID/FILETIME/command/parent identities, image hashes, strict inner1/2/3 and outer1/2/3/4 Job inventories, and complete cleanup. It does not close59/91 formatter cases, Windows CTRL+C, or actual formatter pending file I/O.

Root compiles fixed-name Launcher.dll (Native.cs + Launcher.cs) then Helper.dll (Helper.cs, referencing Launcher.dll) using the configured SDK10 csc under owned Jobs. The two csproj files also describe the source split; project builds must retain repository warning/analyzer rules. Root chooses a separate fresh absolute ArtifactRoot, copies the exact sources/Run.ps1/runtimeconfig there for byte closure, and creates the final immutable manifest plus source-bound compiler reports. packageFiles has at most40 top-level real files and excludes mutable run results. Nested runtimeBinding has candidateSha/treeSha/dotnet/cli/cliSha256/buildReport/buildReportSha256/sourceHashes3/externalFiles13; candidate/tree are caller-reviewed40-hex values. The production build report must actually succeed at that candidate and all real source/binary hashes must match. No machine-specific repository, candidate, artifact or conhost path is baked into execution; conhost uses the actual OS SystemDirectory.

Invoke Run.ps1 with -TaskRoot, -ReviewedManifestSha256, -ReviewedLiveHostIdentityPath and -ReviewedLiveHostIdentitySha256. Only -Mode resume-no-signal is supported. The artifact root must exist, be outside this tracked source directory, have no reparse ancestry, and contain fresh retained stage names. The executing Run.ps1 bytes must match the frozen package. A fresh task-lease.json joins exact root/nonce/manifest/native owner identity; controller/helper verify the same lease and actual live owner before any child work. Runtime descendants stay in the verified owned Jobs; upstream system ancestry remains explicitly incomplete.

Real GetConsoleProcessList raw count/Win32 last error/member arrays are recorded before allocation, after allocation and at cleanup. Pre-allocation must be zero/ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE6, after allocation exact helper1, live console exact helper+CLI2, final console helper1. The conhost identity comes from full Job evidence, never HWND owner inference. Before CLI creation root independently verifies conhost native image/hash/identity and outer3; before CLI resume it verifies full inner3/outer4. Passed predicates reject every child CleanupErrors/PublicationErrors and Job Errors, nonzero natural exit, failed accounting or handle close. Fixture .lease stores full native identity; only exact owned ordinary entries are deleted, with unknown entries retained. No worker install, signal or process-name kill is permitted.
